en: The image shows the interior of an ornate church, with wooden pews, religious statues, elaborate altars, and arched ceilings. The photo is monochrome, possibly sepia-toned, indicating its age. There is a baptismal font in the foreground and the altar area is richly decorated. At the bottom, there is bilingual text in Slovene and German, along with a handwritten date: 25/6 1913.
